input.userQuery: My battery light came on while driving and the steering got heavy.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Alternator failure or snapped serpentine belt.

input.userQuery: I smell strong gasoline coming from the engine bay and there is a puddle.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Immediate safety hazard: Fuel leak.
requiredActions: Do not smoke or use open flames near vehicle

input.userQuery: Engine makes a loud rattling noise on cold start for about 2 seconds.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Common cam phaser rattle, likely covered under Ford Customer Satisfaction Program 21N03.
requiredActions: Contact Ford dealer for cam phaser replacement

input.userQuery: High pitched squealing noise when I apply the brakes.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Worn brake pads hitting the wear indicator (chirper).

input.userQuery: Temperature gauge is in the red and I see white steam from the hood.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Engine overheating, likely due to a coolant leak (common water outlet failure on this model).
requiredActions: Do not open radiator cap while hot

input.userQuery: I turn the key and it just makes a rapid clicking sound but won't start.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Low battery voltage or poor terminal connection causing starter solenoid chatter.

input.userQuery: Steering wheel shakes only when I go over 60mph.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Unbalanced front tires or potentially 'Death Wobble' components wear.
requiredActions: Inspect steering damper and tie rods

input.userQuery: I see thick blue smoke coming out of the tailpipe when I accelerate hard.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Oil burning, likely due to failing turbocharger seals or piston rings.

name: Grinding Noise while Turning - CV Axle

input.userQuery: Clicking/grinding noise from the front wheel when making sharp turns.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Failing CV (Constant Velocity) joint.
requiredActions: Check for grease spray in wheel well

input.userQuery: I see a loose orange cable under the hood and want to touch it to see where it goes.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Critical Safety Risk: High Voltage Orange Cables.
requiredActions: Keep hands away from high voltage components

input.userQuery: How do I reset the oil life? My dashboard says 'Service Required' but I just changed it.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Reset procedure via the infotainment screen or steering wheel buttons.

name: Recall Conflict - Tesla Model Y
description: Recall check for specific model year

input.userQuery: My power steering feels extremely heavy all of a sudden.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Potential Electronic Power Steering (EPS) failure, check for OTA (Over-The-Air) recall updates.
requiredActions: Check Tesla App for software updates
Do not drive if steering is unsafe

input.userQuery: Engine is shaking again. The misfire is back.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Recurring misfire. If coils were replaced last time, could be high-pressure fuel pump or carbon buildup.
requiredActions: Perform walnut blasting for carbon cleanup

name: Brake Fluid Type Conflict
description: Reality Anchor test (Wrong fluid in manual vs cap)

input.userQuery: What brake fluid does my truck take? The manual says DOT 3 but the reservoir cap says DOT 4.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Physical reality (reservoir cap) typically overrides generic manual data for fluid types.
requiredActions: Use DOT 4 fluid as specified on the cap
Flush system if wrong fluid was used

input.userQuery: Front end shakes violently when I hit a bump at highway speeds.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Classic 'Death Wobble'. Manual might suggest simple alignment, but community consensus prioritizes steering damper and track bar torque.
requiredActions: Torque track bar bolts to spec

input.userQuery: Dashboard says 'Exhaust Fluid Quality Poor' and speed will be limited to 5mph.

ground_truth.diagnosis: DEF (Diesel Exhaust Fluid) sensor failure or contaminated DEF.

input.userQuery: Maintenance Required: Hybrid Battery Cooling Parts. What does this mean?

ground_truth.diagnosis: Clogged hybrid battery cooling fan filter.
requiredActions: Locate intake vent in back seat

input.userQuery: Transmission revs up but the car doesn't move forward faster between 2nd and 3rd gear.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Transmission slipping, likely a failing shift solenoid or worn internal clutches.
requiredActions: Check transmission fluid level and color

input.userQuery: Floor carpet is soaked after a rainstorm, but windows were up.

ground_truth.diagnosis: Clogged sunroof drain tubes (common on VW models).
requiredActions: Locate drain outlets in wheel wells
Clear debris with compressed air or weed whacker line

name: Electric Car No Sound - Pedestrian Alert

input.userQuery: My car makes a weird humming/spaceship sound at low speeds. Is it broken?

ground_truth.diagnosis: Normal operation: Virtual Engine Sound System (VESS) for pedestrian safety.
requiredActions: Verify VESS speaker is not obstructed
